questions.solution: • 'said' will be used instead of 'has said' because the initial part of the sentence 'I don't know the reason why he' indicates an event in the past. questions.question: Four sentences are given below. Find the odd sentence out. A. Subsequent generations of kings hid their tombs in the Valley of the Kings in an attempt to elude the robbers. B. The most imposing tombs are the famous pyramids, shaped like the sacred mound where the gods first appeared in the creation story. C. The ongoing deciphering of hieroglyphic writings and research on the life of the peasants is answering several questions on Egyptian culture. D. The gigantic pyramids were conspicuous targets for tomb robbers, whose plundering jeopardizes the hope for eternal life.
questions.questionHtml:
Four sentences are given below. Find the odd sentence out.

A. Subsequent generations of kings hid their tombs in the Valley of the Kings in an attempt to elude the robbers.

B. The most imposing tombs are the famous pyramids, shaped like the sacred mound where the gods first appeared in the creation story.

C. The ongoing deciphering of hieroglyphic writings and research on the life of the peasants is answering several questions on Egyptian culture.

D. The gigantic pyramids were conspicuous targets for tomb robbers, whose plundering jeopardizes the hope for eternal life.
questions.solution: C) Sentence C is the odd one out because it does not specifically address the topic of tombs or burial practices but rather speaks about Egyptian culture in a broader sense, including aspects beyond tomb architecture and security.
